integrations.mappingHelp:
Map target fields to dot-paths in each result item.

Example for {"persons": [{"name_full": "...", "acc": "..."}]}:
{
  "name":        "name_full",
  "identifier":  "acc",
  "description": "aff_name_en"
}

Supported target fields:
  name, authorized_form, agent_type,
  date_from, date_to, description,
  identifier, website

integrations.resultPathHint: dot-path to the array, e.g. persons or hits.hit — leave empty if response is already an array

integrations.intro: Configure external APIs for authority lookups and vocabulary fields. Searches are proxied through the server so credentials stay private.
